ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central white contiguous region; thick, irregular black pigmentation band localized along the entire length of the trailing edge; dense black mottling and focal spotting concentrated at the peduncle-fluke junction area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an estimated pixel angle of 55 degrees and a high-depth bounding box extending towards the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) recorded along the continuous trailing boundary, most prominent on the distal portions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall concave curve fitted to the trailing edges, transitioning from the lobe tips inward to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Prominent, high-contrast, textured brownish-white clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes, consistent with sessile barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned vertical dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the white ventral surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on both lobe tips; multiple small, dark circular puncture-style scars distributed across the central white pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant occlusion of the lower fluke region due to high-velocity water spray and droplet scattering at the water-air interface.
